Container.Name: Blink-Camera-Relay
Container.Overview: Unofficial Blink live-view bridge with web onboarding, RTSP and ONVIF in one container. Cloud login is still required. Set the server LAN IP and a dashboard password. Use a trusted LAN only. Requires free TCP ports 8787, 8554, 8555 and the selected ONVIF port (default 8080), plus UDP 3702. Session renewals can cause video gaps.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent camera configuration and account tokens

Config.Name: Advertised LAN IPv4
Config.Description: Address reachable by your recorder: with Host networking, use the Unraid LAN/bond address; with a dedicated container IP on a custom network, use the container address. If DHCP has not assigned it yet, leave blank and set the LAN address in the app dashboard before enabling ONVIF.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: At least 12 characters; dashboard username is admin
